test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

A. The flute seller stands in a corner of the square near the hotel.

B. From time to time, he stands the pole on the ground, selects a flute and plays a tune.

C. In his hand is a pole from which protrude about fifty flutes in all directions.

D. They are all made from hollow bamboo stems.
solution:
The correct answer is **'ACDB'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given question is an example of** sentence jumble.**
 
• The sentence starts with **'A' **as it contains the **subject 'The flute seller'** and* his whereabouts*, giving the passage a proper **introduction** -* The flute seller stands in a corner of the square near the hotel.*
 
• **Sentence C** follows** A** adding details about **what the flute seller was holding in his hands** - *In his hand is a pole from which protrude about fifty flutes in all directions.*
 
• **Sentence D** follows **C** describing **what the flutes are made up of** - *They are all made from hollow bamboo stems.*
 
• Finally,** sentence B** is used as the **conclusion** telling us **what he was actually doing there** -* From time to time, he stands the pole on the ground, selects a flute and plays a tune.*
 
• Hence the correct sequence is **ACBD.**
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 1.**

**The passage after rearranging the sentences will be:** *The flute seller stands in a corner of the square near the hotel. In his hand is a pole from which protrude about fifty flutes in all directions. They are all made from hollow bamboo stems. From time to time, he stands the pole on the ground, selects a flute and plays a tune.*
